## Changes
- **Version under the title** – the ArrHub version is now shown under the ArrHub title in the header instead of next to ⚙ Settings. Click it to open Settings; when an update is available it turns yellow with a dot and the tooltip names the new version.

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.10.2   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                           # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.10.1...v1.10.2
